patterns.name: Dynamic stage region removal is asymmetric
patterns.claim: Removing the head recycles it. Removing a matched non-head only unlinks it; an absent non-NULL node is inserted into the available list. Update decrements only positive lifetimes. Get returns the first connected region strictly inside its XY radius, including zero-valued attributes.
